San Francisco's Mission District boasts a vibrant array of bakeries, each offering unique flavors and specialties. Here are some top-rated options you might consider:

**[Kahnfections](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kahnfections%2C+San+Francisco%2C+CA?utm_source=openai)**
_San Francisco, CA_
Renowned for its handcrafted biscuits, pastries, and breakfast sandwiches.

**[Tartine Bakery](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Tartine+Bakery%2C+San+Francisco%2C+CA?utm_source=openai)**
_San Francisco, CA_
A legendary institution known for its exceptional sourdough bread and French-inspired pastries.

**[Arizmendi Valencia Bakery](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Arizmendi+Valencia+Bakery%2C+San+Francisco%2C+CA?utm_source=openai)**
_San Francisco, CA_
A cherished worker-owned institution with daily changing thin-crust pizzas and excellent sourdough loaves.
